commandFloorItWell: Command: Floor it. We'll call the sandbox a ramp.
commandTheGaugeSays: Command: The gauge says empty. The gauge is usually wrong. Not today.
commandYourRidesHere: Command: Your ride's here. Hovercraft. It's, uh, in a hurry.
pilotSixtyMetresParachutes: Pilot: Sixty metres. Parachute's on your back. Probably.
pilotMakeThatFive: Pilot: Make that five. I rounded.
pilotThisIsYour: Pilot: This is your stop. Jump, or I tip you out.
pilotThatNoiseWas: Pilot: That noise was nothing. Good luck down there.
commandGetToYour: Command: Get to your weapon, soldier.
commandAnyTimeNow: Command: Any time now. We're on a budget.
commandFineWellMail: Command: Fine. We'll mail it to you.
commandPatchUpWell: Command: Patch up. We'll call it the plan.
commandIsThatCar: Command: Is that car supposed to do that?
commandNobodyWasDriving: Command: Nobody was driving that. Carry on.
commandItsLosingAir: Command: It's losing air. Ignore that.
commandWellThatsOne: Command: Well. That's one way down.
pilotTaxiForOne: Pilot: Taxi for one. Ladder's down.
pilotEverybodyInGood: Pilot: Everybody in? Good. Nobody else was coming.
commandNiceWorkNothing: Command: Nice work. Nothing could possibly go wrong now.
commandLastStretchNothing: Command: Last stretch. Nothing could possibly go wrong. Again.
contactOverWalls: Contact! Over the wall! Both walls!
choiceHome: Command: Health crate at HEAD, right behind you. Then rally on {folder}.
choiceCall: Command: Your call. Rally on {folder}, or fall back to HEAD and patch up.
choiceFallBack: Command: Fall back to HEAD and patch up.
coxswainThirtySeconds: Coxswain: Thirty seconds. Keep your head down and your commits small.
coxswainGrassCounts: Coxswain: Yes, it's a landing craft. Yes, that's a lawn. It's amphibious. Grass counts.
coxswainRampsDown: Coxswain: Ramp's down. Go, go, go. Mind the koi.
commandSecureMain: Command: Secure main. The codes are on it, and so, shortly, is everyone else.
commandFireMission: Command: Fire mission on {folder}. Danger close. Define close.
commandShotOut: Command: Shot, over. Rounds in the air for forty seconds. Give or take forty.
commandSplash: Command: Splash. Mostly on them. Mostly.
sitrepBranching: Command: {folder} merged. Sitrep: the Conflict is reconsidering its branching strategy.
sitrepNotTheCodes: Command: Good. Intelligence says the codes were moved to a file called definitely_not_the_codes.txt.
sitrepHouseplant: Command: That's another one. The admiral says well done. The admiral is a houseplant.
sitrepWhyMain: Command: {folder} is ours. Remind me why anyone committed the launch codes to main.
commandVampires: Command: Raid inbound. Vampires, vampires, vamp... folders. Folders inbound. Sorry. Old habits.
commandMedic: Command: You're at {hp}. Medic says walk it off. Medic is also a houseplant.
